development_inference.consequence: Keep intended patient-important outcomes independently interpretable, with sufficient baseline range and an explicit interpretation of endpoint availability and missingness. Use lesion, pain, rescue and burden evidence according to the claim actually supported.
development_inference.limits: The HS result cannot reject HHD efficacy, establish an HHD systemic exposure window, or require superiority on every secondary outcome.

unresolved: Baseline pain, itch and BSA distributions; sponsor explanation of low baseline symptoms
Exact daily missingness, full model-contributing participants/visits and mapping of dropout reasons to endpoint absence
MMRM description versus ANCOVA statistical-method field, full implemented imputation and sensitivity analyses
Response numerators not directly reported; no inference from rounded percentages
Full journal manuscript and detailed extension efficacy results
Measured HS systemic drug exposure and transfer to HHD erosions

closeout.reopen_for: A new readable primary source that resolves named baseline, missing-data, model-implementation, extension-efficacy or PK fields. Phase 3 outcomes are a separate evidence event; no further retrieval chase in this sprint.

participant_flow.interpretation: Controlled-period noncompletion is 10 versus 3; extension noncompletion is 3 versus 8. Period-specific flow does not establish reasons for each absent endpoint or diary score.

baseline_results.interpretation: Reported demographic imbalances are descriptive; no treatment-effect explanation or subgroup effect is inferred.
